[IDSP.6.8] Cooldown ([LCRS.8]) is enforced engine-side. The compiler lowers
`cooldown: <DUR>` on a `call` to an inline `FN_RATE_ALLOW` gate inside the
`ACTION_CALL` action's `expr` in the rule's `TerminalNode` atom ([RDSC.4a.8]),
as [IRET.25.5.1] lays out; the engine tracks the window per call site and key ([LCRS.8.2])
and the gate suppresses the call when it has not elapsed. An integrator does not implement cooldown in the call
callback.
